assertions.name: six_crossing_shape_discriminants_verified
assertions.source: Each SnapPy shape is a root of its PARI-algdep minimal polynomial to |p(z)|<1e-60 at 90 digits, and the sympy discriminant equals the stated prime (6_1: 257, 6_2: 1777). Formalized (6_1) as ∏(yi-yj)^2 = 257 in SixOneShapeDiscriminant.lean.

description: Reproducibility witness for the 6-crossing shape-field arithmetic fingerprints formalized by QOU/QBeta/SixOneShapeDiscriminant.lean. Shapes from snappy.Manifold('6_1'/'6_2') (dec_prec=90), minimal polynomials from PARI algdep; re-verified here with mpmath+sympy only (no SnapPy at run time). 6_1: x^4-3x^3+6x^2-5x+2, disc 257 (prime); 6_2: x^5-3x^4+5x^3-5x^2+4x-1, disc 1777 (prime). Each shape is a root to |p(z)|<1e-60 at 90 digits; discriminants match and are prime. GGM works explicit saddle curves only for 4_1/5_2, so the 6-crossing datum is taken from the hyperbolic geometry (SnapPy) instead. No fit; nothing wired.
